text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
B-Boss... I am so sorry.
My carelessness has caused you trouble...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it is not a serious injury.
Now, let us return to training.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Because I don't have time to be resting
over an injury like this, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
It was indeed a thoughtless remark on my part.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will take today off to rest, sir! As soon as my injury heals, I look forward to your strict guidance once more!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that won't be a problem at all.
I'll head to the gym right away!

With her injury worsening,
Fenomeno was forced to take a break for a while...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"My worries were unfounded after all.
Let's keep up this momentum and make up for lost time!"
By keeping the training within safe limits, Fenomeno's injury made a smooth recovery.
